column2: A giant whirlpool rises underfoot and sucks enemies to the center. Walls of water rise high around it, then collapse inward all at once
True Secret Art Ten Thousand Demons: demon claws rise twelve times from the sea of blood
True Secret Art Nine Dragons: nine gold dragons rise, circle the sky and slam down
True Secret Art Thunder Net: a lightning net links every enemy
Secret Art Thousand-Armed Tathagata: a many-armed golden Tathagata strikes and a heavenly palm presses down
Secret Art Shadowless Heaven Kill: marks carved on each enemy in the dark burst at once
Secret Art Ten Thousand Currents: a whirlpool pulls in and walls of water collapse
Fire the blood at your nails as needles into four nearby enemies. 1s later they burst inside, draining HP equal to the burst
A giant hand of blood rises ahead and grabs nearby enemies. It squeezes three times, then slams them into the ground
Unleash a gold dragon's roar ahead. Enemies in the cone fly far and freeze for 1s (unblockable)
A palm force shaped like a gold dragon's head stretches far ahead, piercing every enemy it touches, and bursts at the end
Strike the ground to carve purple thunder seals in four spots. For 2.6s, enemies stepping on them are struck by lightning (twice per seal), then they all burst
Gather lightning in your fist and fire it straight ahead. Pierces every enemy in the line, and the line crackles for 1.2s
A big golden bell falls from the sky and covers you (1.4s invincible). Each of its three rings pushes the area away; the last is the biggest
Throw a vajra. It flies out and returns to your hand, hitting once going and once coming back
Two shadow clones split off to your sides, each pouncing on a nearby enemy and kicking three times
Only your shadow slides forward, pinning the shadows of enemies it steps on (bound 1.6s). You move to the shadow's end and kick back
Three water drops orbit you for 3s, hitting enemies they touch, then spread as a wave
Scalding water pillars rise under six nearby enemies one by one, launching them skyward
Roll a wheel of fire forward. It hits enemies it touches, and its path burns for 2s
Leap up and land, spreading a ring of fire. Enemies are hit as the ring passes
The ground ahead swells. Lava spurts under each enemy, then a volcano erupts at the center and rains ten fireballs
Trap three nearby enemies in water bubbles and float them. They're fried for 1.6s, then pop
Seven water spears fall from the sky onto enemies in turn (in a line ahead if there are none)
A giant water whale bursts from underfoot and leaps far forward. Every enemy where it crashes down is crushed
Release a small whirlwind. For 3s it chases nearby enemies lifting them up, then scatters and strikes
Leap up and pull down the sky's wind. Nearby enemies are sucked to the center and pinned to the ground (1.2s stun)
Secret Art Volcano Collapse: lava spurts under each enemy and a volcano rains fireballs
Secret Art Whale Descends: a giant water whale bursts up and crashes down
. At the end a shockwave hits the area
Only those who know the Plum Blossom Fist and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Cherry Fan Immortal on the cherry hill deep in the Plum Garden
A style beyond Plum Blossom Storm. Each time the cherry fans in both hands open, petals scatter as blades. Flowers are most beautiful the moment they fall.
Cherry Blossom: keep hitting within 1.2s to stack petals (max 30). At full, Z bursts into a huge Thousand Cherry Bloom. An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Open both fans and throw them to the sides. They arc forward shedding petals and return, cutting enemies on the way out and back
Become petals and glide forward (invincible). Three flower shadows stay on your path, swing their fans in turn, then burst into petals
A giant cherry fan opens in the sky. It sweeps the ground ahead twice like a blade, then snaps shut and a petal storm wraps the area
Ten Thousand Cherries Cut the Moon

Ultimate Art. Cut through ten nearby enemies unseen, leaving sword marks in the sky. The world freezes gray for a beat, then a blade wind wraps the enemies and bursts, splitting even the screen in two (invincible meanwhile)
Only those who know the Drunken Fist and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Dead-Drunk Immortal on the wine-jar porch south of the Drunken Inn
A style beyond the Drunken Fist. Staggering across the world with one bottle and one necktie. Every move that looks like a fall is an attack, and the moment you collapse is your fastest.
Dead Drunk: you can't block (blocked hits still land). Instead the deflect window is wide, and you have a 30% chance to dodge while moving or using skills. An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Shake the bottle and spark its mouth. Green flames spray ahead for 1.6s, burning a cone
Take eight zigzag steps as if about to fall. Each step sweeps the area, and nothing can hit you meanwhile
Throw the bottle high. It shatters and wine rains down soaking enemies, one spark sets the ground ablaze in green fire, and the shadows of eight drunken immortals pounce at once
Ultimate Art. In a moment where the world seems to stop, roll in with ever-faster forward rolls (invincible meanwhile), rain hundreds of punches on enemies, then smash the bottle to finish
Only those who know the Blood Demon Hand and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Blood Moon Immortal at the blood-moon altar beyond the Blood Cult's walls
A style beyond the Blood Demon Hand. The nails have grown into a scythe. Each swing of the great blood-red scythe hangs a crimson crescent in the sky. The more you bleed, the deeper you cut.
Blood Pact: the lower your HP, the more damage you deal (up to 1.6x near zero). Heal 3% of damage dealt. An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Throw the scythe on a chain. Hook three nearby enemies with the tip, drag them in front of you, then cut in a full circle
Leap into the sky and drive the scythe down upside-down. A crimson crescent is carved into the ground ahead and bursts a beat later
A giant blood scythe rises behind you and sweeps the area twice. Each enemy cut is branded crimson, and the brands burst at once when the scythe hits the ground. Heals you for what you cut

Ultimate Art. The sky turns crimson and a giant red moon rises (invincible meanwhile). The moonlit scythe becomes hundreds of crimson crescents raining on the area, and a final stroke reaching the moon splits sky, earth and the screen
Only those who know the Thunderclap Fist and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Thunder Heaven Immortal on the iron-pillar peak at the east cliff of the Storm Plateau
A style beyond the Thunderclap Fist. Heaven's lightning dwells in the bracers on both arms. Fists faster than sound, and every third punch the sky answers.
Heavenly Thunder: every three hits chain heavenly thunder jumps around (wider and stronger). Light body (speed x1.25). An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Reach out and drive lightning into six nearby enemies in turn (paralyze)
Summon a dark cloud overhead. For 2.4s lightning strikes nearby enemies, ending with a great bolt
A lightning dragon rises from you, circles the sky and slams into enemies six times. At the end it falls on your spot and thunder bursts
Ultimate Art. The sky splits and a giant eye of thunder opens between the clouds (invincible meanwhile). Lightning pours on the area, ending with a pillar of lightning from sky to ground
Only those who know the Azure Sea Fist and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Ancient Whale Immortal on the whale-bone rock on the west sea shore
A style beyond the Azure Sea Fist. The pearls at the wrists hold the sea's breath. It comes like the flood tide and drags away like the ebb. Whales still live in the deepest sea.

Tide: every three hits a whirlpool forms at the target, pulling in the area before bursting into a water pillar. Knockback x1.4, faster on the current (speed x1.15). An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Gather the sea at your fingertips and throw a swirling spear of water. It pierces every enemy ahead, then becomes a whirlpool for 1.2s pulling in the area before bursting into a water pillar
Cup your hands and sing the song of the deep sea. The whale's cry spreads as three rings of water one after another, pushing enemies away and slowing them. The last ring is the widest
The ground in a 26-stud radius becomes sea. Four great waves roll to the center from all sides sweeping enemies together, then a giant whirlpool rises at the center and swallows them all

Ultimate Art. The sky darkens and the ground becomes deep sea (invincible meanwhile). An ancient whale bursts from below, passes overhead and leaps high. Enemies under its shadow are swept up by the current, and as it falls into the sea ahead a giant tsunami covers the area
Only those who know the Starry River Fist and reach Beyond Heaven meet the Star Counting Immortal at the observatory on the south end of the Nebula Garden
A style beyond the Starry River Fist. The stars once held in the fist now hang from the staff tip. Every swing opens a magic circle, rains stars and draws constellations in the sky.

Star Circle: each hit has a 25% chance (guaranteed on the fourth) to open a magic circle around the target that shoots stars. Balance damage x1.3, skill cooldowns 15% shorter. An Ultimate Art (X) above the Secret Art
Open a magic circle at the staff tip and fire five stars. They home in on nearby enemies and burst small where they hit
Draw a big magic circle on the ground ahead. Seven stars rise around it and link one by one into a constellation, pulling enemies in; when complete, a pillar of starlight rises

The staff grows huge and plants itself in the ground. Purple, indigo and yellow mist rises in a 24-stud radius, and stars swirl inside into a galaxy. The swirl keeps pulling in and hitting enemies, then the galaxy collapses to the center and bursts

Ultimate Art. The sky turns to night (invincible meanwhile) and a big indigo dome covering 34 studs settles down. Magic circles open all over inside, raining stars and meteors. At the end constellations light up on the dome's surface and everything bursts at once
Only those at Half-Immortal meet the Tree Sage seated on the mossy dais of the Myriad Tree Grove deep in the southwest woods
A tree doesn't hurry. But it doesn't stop either. A fist that flows softly like wind in bamboo and lands heavy like a thousand-year ginkgo. At the end the whole forest stands up.

Bamboo Shoots: every four hits bamboo shoots spear up under the target and launch them. Sturdy body (balance x1.4). Secret Art Sacred Tree Descends: a thousand-year ginkgo rises and rains golden leaves
Press the ground with your palm. Seven bamboo stalks spear up in a straight line ahead, launching enemies above; they stand as a grove for a moment, then sink scattering leaves
Turn your hands and dozens of green leaves swirl around you. They pick eight nearby enemies and fly in three streams to cut them, and you recover 6% HP

Kneel and touch the ground, and a thousand-year ginkgo rises high behind you. For 2.4s golden leaves pour over a 24-stud radius cutting enemies, and the forest's energy restores 12% of your HP. At the end the tree glows and golden leaves storm in all directions
Leap into the sky and strike the nearest enemy as lightning. The ground splits four ways where you land as lightning runs along it

Raise both arms to summon a thunder star with two spinning rings overhead. Six small stars break off and orbit, each firing lightning at a nearby enemy for 2.4s. At the end they merge again and the thunder star falls to the ground

Ultimate Art. The sky turns crimson and a giant red moon rises (invincible meanwhile). A winged demon lord rises behind you swinging a great scythe while crimson crescents pour for 2.4s. At the end the demon's scythe splits sky, earth and the screen

Ultimate Art. Eight thunder drums appear in a ring in the sky behind you (invincible meanwhile). Each of sixteen beats drives lightning from a drum into an enemy, faster and faster, with thunder rolling around every fourth beat. At the end the drums merge into one thunder orb that slams down
After one rebirth, pass the first Rebirth Trial and the shadow of your past life leaves this fist behind
A fist that carries the wheel of rebirth on its back. Each time it lands, your past self strikes the same spot a beat later. As the wheel turns, the six realms turn with it.
Past-Life Echo: every four hits the shadow of your past life appears and strikes the same spot again. Throw, recall and raise the rebirth wheel on your back

Throw the rebirth wheel on your back. The golden wheel rolls upright 26 studs ahead, while two indigo wheels from past lives fan out to the sides behind it. All three carve golden tracks in the ground, then return to your back
Slide 18 studs forward cutting (invincible). Shadows of your three past lives stay behind, then charge the same path one by one, cutting, and burst in a wheel pattern as they merge into you

The rebirth wheel rises into the sky and grows house-sized. Six orbs (the six realms) fall one by one as pillars of light at six spots around the enemy, the pillars link into a hexagram on the ground, and the giant wheel lies down, grinds over the star and slams in

Ultimate Art. Cutscene: the sky fades to indigo, a giant rebirth wheel hangs behind you, and your four past selves rise from the ground (invincible meanwhile). The army of past lives takes turns striking enemies. The wheel lies on the ground trapping the area and pulls them in, and when everyone gathers to you, you are reborn in a golden burst
After two rebirths, pass the second Rebirth Trial and a karma-laden shadow leaves this fist behind
Karma piled up over two lives has turned into black flame. With heated chains wrapped around your arms, each punch passes karma to the foe, and when it's full hellfire rises underfoot.
Retribution: every five hits brands the target with karma, and half a beat later a black hellfire pillar rises underfoot and launches them. The more you're hit, the heavier the fire (balance x1.25)
Hurl the heated chains on both arms. They catch three nearby enemies, black fire spreads along the chains, drags them in, then bursts as hellfire underfoot

Become black flame and rush 22 studs ahead (invincible). The ground you pass splits into burning lava cracks while chains lash both sides. Soon eight fire pillars erupt in sequence like a fuse, ending in a big blast

Punch the ground and it splits as a giant hell gate carved with red script rises. It opens pouring red light and black fire, and chains from inside drag nearby enemies to the gate. The gate slams shut, sinks into the ground and bursts in a ring of hellfire

Ultimate Art. Cutscene: the sky turns crimson, the ground splits and eight black fire pillars rise around you (invincible meanwhile). Each pillar drives hellfire into an enemy, and two giant hands of fire rise from the ground to clasp and crush the center. The eight pillars gather overhead into a black sun, and when you strike the ground it falls and bursts into a dome of hellfire
After three rebirths, pass the third Rebirth Trial and a shadow turned to ash leaves this fist behind
After three lives, you learned that everything passes. Everything you touch cracks, and what cracks scatters as ash. Flowers fall, sand runs out, candles go out.
Impermanence: 25% chance for attacks to slip past you. Every four hits porcelain-like cracks spread on the target, and soon they shatter into ash. Fast (speed x1.3)
Turn to ash and graze 20 studs ahead (invincible). Five ash figures of you remain on the path, then crack and crumble in turn, striking the area
A big ash-gray flower blooms on the ground ahead. Its eight petals wrap enemies and pull them in, then the flower withers into ash and bursts

A big hourglass descends over a 26-stud radius. While the sand runs, enemies inside are slowed under a rain of ash. When the sand runs out, the hourglass cracks and shatters, scattering everything in a sandstorm
Flowers in a Mirror, Moon in Water

Ultimate Art. The world loses its color (invincible meanwhile). Twelve mirrors three times a person's height rise in a 36-stud circle. Glass shadows of you leap from the mirrors to strike enemies and return to other mirrors again and again. Cracks spread across every mirror, they all shatter toward the center, and everything turns to ash
After four rebirths, pass the final Rebirth Trial and the shadows of four lives merge to leave this fist behind

The fist of one who has passed all four lives. In the bare-handed martial world there is only one king. Raise your fist and a golden fist descends from the sky with it; at the end, a golden king rises.
King's Fist: every four hits a giant golden fist from the sky slams the target. It holds the three fists before it: 10% of attacks miss you, and you heal 1.5% of damage dealt
Six golden fists appear behind you in a fan and thrust 28 studs one by one. Finally a big king's fist pierces the center and golden shockwaves burst in a line
A red road unrolls ahead from your feet; leap high along it and land 24 studs ahead (invincible). Eight golden crown spikes rise around where you land, then collapse inward and burst

Eight golden pillars rise around you forming a king's arena and pull enemies in. A giant red-sleeved golden fist appears at each pillar and punches the center in turn, and finally a fist from the ground launches everyone skyward

Ultimate Art. Cutscene: the sky splits gold (invincible meanwhile). Gold rises from your body and a giant golden king (your form) wearing a crown and cape stands behind you. The king draws back its fist, gathers the sky's gold and drives it into the strongest enemy. The ground caves in with three shockwaves, four golden pillars race out in a cross, and a crown of light descends from the sky and bursts
After two rebirths, listen to the dream stories of the Dream Sage dozing at the Lotus Pavilion
A fist that walks through the dream of a second life. You fight half asleep. In dreams, doors open in midair, earth and sky flip, and the moon is within reach.
Dream Path: every four hits a dream door opens in the air behind the target, swallowing them and spitting them out. Light as sleep: 15% of attacks slip past you, speed x1.2

Walk 18 studs ahead with your eyes closed (invincible meanwhile). Moonlit stepping stones appear one by one in the air, forming a night-sky path, and enemies on it nod off (0.8s stun). At the end the stones rise as stardust in turn and strike the sleeping enemies again
The ground ahead becomes a night sky and gravity flips. Enemies inside float upward as if falling into the sky, then slam into the ground when the dream rights itself

A 26-stud radius becomes a dream. A big moon rises in the night sky, and small grassy islands, endless stairs and doors drift about. Each time a door opens and shuts beside an enemy, the dream cuts them; at the end everything falls away and you wake

Ultimate Art. Cutscene: night falls and a full moon fills the sky (invincible meanwhile). The ground in a 40-stud radius becomes a still night lake reflecting the moon, with lanterns and doors floating up. Enemies drift up as if asleep and are wrapped in a whirl of stars; finally the moon slowly descends, and the moment it touches the lake a white light silently spreads and they all fall
null. This style's description has been erased. Where the fist lands becomes empty, and what becomes empty is never filled again.
Blank: every four hits the target is erased into a black square, then returns like a broken screen. Glitch: 12% of attacks slip past you (bzzt). Speed x1.25
A white selection box is drawn ahead and blinks. Everything in it is blacked out, then the box breaks into pixel shards
Teleport between four nearby enemies like a stuttering screen, striking each (invincible meanwhile). Misaligned afterimages remain, and you appear behind the last enemy

A 26-stud radius loses its color and the ground becomes a black void with a white grid. Red null text drifts over it, pulling enemies to the center to erase them, then the void shrinks to a point and bursts into white noise

Ultimate Art. The screen breaks (invincible meanwhile). Black screen cracks slide across a 40-stud radius and blank boxes fall on enemies from the sky. Everything stops, colors invert, and with one beep the area collapses into pixel shards
Only those who build Sun-Moon Fist mastery to 20 and are reborn three times meet the Twilight Fist Sovereign on the Heavenly Rebirth Terrace
